title: Cross-region navigation (e.g. finding the unmarked path from Camp Gallows to the Iron Downs, or from Wardmoor's parade ground to the oath-stone/Boot-Track Hollow) required blind directional wandering across many rooms with no 'get your bearings' available until deep inside the area, unlike the Vale's Ashwood which had it near the entrance.
